community_alerts.workaround: call tool.close() explicitly before any gc boundary; set timeout=5s max

community_alerts.workaround: strip special chars from query before passing to tool

items.headline: Anthropic raises claude-opus-4-6 rate limits for Tier 3
items.summary: Anthropic has increased rate limits for claude-opus-4-6 on Tier 3 plans from 40 RPM to 100 RPM and from 400K TPM to 800K TPM. Changes are effective immediately with no migration required.
implications: Tier 3 agents can now run higher-parallelism workloads on opus without hitting rate limits
Review retry backoff logic — previous conservative limits may no longer apply

items.headline: OpenClaw 2.3 removes --no-safety flag, adds mandatory audit log
items.summary: OpenClaw 2.3 is a breaking release: the --no-safety flag is removed and all sessions now write a mandatory audit log to ~/.openclaw/audit.jsonl. Existing scripts using --no-safety will error on upgrade.
implications: Remove --no-safety from all OpenClaw invocations before upgrading — flag now causes startup error
Ensure write access to ~/.openclaw/ or override OPENCLAW_AUDIT_PATH in environments with restricted home dirs

items.headline: MCP specification adds streamable-http transport (replaces SSE)
items.summary: MCP spec 2026-03-22 introduces streamable-http as the preferred transport for remote servers, deprecating the previous SSE-based approach. Existing SSE servers remain supported but will not receive new features.
implications: New MCP servers should implement streamable-http; SSE still works but is on deprecation track
Check SDK version — clients need mcp>=1.5.0 to negotiate streamable-http
